name: kinoa-qa
description: QA plugin with three skills: testplan builds Allure TestOps test cases from a Jira Story + Confluence PRD + linked Figma mockups, enriched by OpenSpec specs; smoke-plan turns a Story into a Smoke test Jira sub-task; smoke-run runs that sub-task in a browser via the Playwright MCP and reports back to Jira. Standalone, decoupled from kinoa-dev.
